2607.02504.title: Reasoning LLM Improves Speaker Recognition in Long-form TV Dramas
2607.02504.paper_summary: Long-form TV dramas present a formidable challenge for comprehensive video understanding, where deciphering complex storyline often relies on \textbf{speaker recognition}, the task of accurately attributing each spoken utterance to its respective character. In this paper, we advance this field through two primary contributions. (1) We introduce \textbf{DramaSR-532K}, a large-scale benchmark comprising 532K annotated dialogue lines across more than 900 unique characters, necessitating the integration of auditory, linguistic, and visual cues for speaker recognition. (2) We propose \textbf{DramaSR-LRM}, a robust approach built upon a large reasoning model (LRM). DramaSR-LRM is designed to autonomously aggregate contextual evidence via multimodal tool-use, synthesizing diverse inputs to achieve high-fidelity attribution. Experimental results demonstrate that DramaSR-LRM significantly outperforms existing baselines, particularly on short utterances where acoustic biometrics are inherently unreliable. \textit{All the data and code will be made publicly available at the project page: https://www.github.com/198808xc/DramaSR-LRM.}
2607.02504.paper_summary_zh: 長篇電視劇對於全面視頻理解提出了巨大的挑戰，在這裡，解讀複雜的故事情節通常依賴於 \textbf{說話者識別}，這是一項準確將每個口語表達歸屬於其相應角色的任務。在本文中，我們通過兩個主要貢獻推進這一領域。 (1) 我們介紹了 \textbf{DramaSR-532K}，這是一個大規模基準，包含532K註釋對話行，涵蓋900多個獨特角色，這需要整合聽覺、語言和視覺線索以進行說話者識別。 (2) 我們提出了 \textbf{DramaSR-LRM}，這是一種基於大型推理模型（LRM）的穩健方法。DramaSR-LRM旨在通過多模態工具使用自主聚合上下文證據，綜合多樣化的輸入以實現高保真度的歸屬。實驗結果表明，DramaSR-LRM顯著超越現有基準，特別是在聲學生物特徵本質上不可靠的短語中。\textit{所有數據和代碼將在項目頁面公開提供：https://www.github.com/198808xc/DramaSR-LRM.}
